(module asl-syntax/tests/js/lexTest
                             
  :x [runTests]
  :i [(asl-syntax/core/source :a src)
      (asl-syntax/core/tree :a tr)
      (asl-syntax/core/print :a pr)
      (asl-syntax/js/lex :a lex)])

fn testRegexVsDiv -> Bool
  (let [(toks1 (lex/lexJsText "x / y / z"))
        (toks2 (lex/lexJsText "return /abc/g;"))
        (toks3 (lex/lexJsText "const r = /foo\\/bar/i;"))
        (toks4 (lex/lexJsText "(a + b) / 2"))
        (toks5 (lex/lexJsText "[ /x/, /y/ ]"))]
    (do
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks1 2) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "punct") "div punct 1")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks1 6) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "punct") "div punct 2")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks2 2) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "regex") "return regex")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks3 6) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "regex") "assign regex")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks4 8) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "punct") "paren div")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks5 2) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "regex") "bracket regex 1")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks5 5) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "regex") "bracket regex 2")
      true)))

fn testTemplates -> Bool
  (let [(toks1 (lex/lexJsText "`simple template`"))
        (toks2 (lex/lexJsText "`hello ${name}!`"))
        (toks3 (lex/lexJsText "`outer ${`inner ${x}`} end`"))]
    (do
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks1 0) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "template") "simple tpl")
      (assert (> (listLength toks2) 3) "interp tpl length")
      (assert (> (listLength toks3) 5) "nested tpl length")
      true)))

fn testBigInts -> Bool
  (let [(toks (lex/lexJsText "123n 0x1fn 0b101n 0o77n"))]
    (do
      (assert (= (listLength toks) 7) "bigint tokens count")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 0) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "number") "dec bigint")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 2) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "number") "hex bigint")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 4) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "number") "bin bigint")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 6) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "number") "oct bigint")
      true)))

fn testNumbers -> Bool
  (let [(toks (lex/lexJsText "0b1010 0o755 0xdead_beef 1_000_000 1.5e-3 .5"))]
    (do
      (assert (= (listLength toks) 11) "number forms count")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 0) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "number") "bin num")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 2) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "number") "oct num")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 4) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "number") "hex num")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 6) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "number") "sep num")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 8) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "number") "exp num")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 10) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "number") "dot num")
      true)))

fn testUnicode -> Bool
  (let [(toks (lex/lexJsText "\\u0061bc foo\\u0061 foo\\u{61}bar π élan"))]
    (do
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 0) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "ident") "escape start ident")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 2) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "ident") "escape cont ident")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 4) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "ident") "brace escape ident")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 6) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "ident") "greek ident")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 8) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "ident") "accent ident")
      true)))

fn testHashbangAndNewlines -> Bool
  (let [(code "#!/usr/bin/env node\r\nconst x = 1;\na\rb\nc\n")
        (toks (lex/lexJsText code))]
    (do
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 0) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "hashbang") "hashbang kind")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 1) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "newline") "crlf kind")
      true)))

fn testJsx -> Bool
  (let [(toks (lex/lexJsGoal (stringToBytes "hello world <div />") (lex/goalJsxText)))]
    (do
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 0) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "jsxText") "jsx text token")
      (assert (= (optionOr (listGet toks 1) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)).kind     "punct") "jsx tag start punct")
      true)))

fn verifyRoundTrip path: String text: String -> Bool
  (let [(src (src/makeSource path text))
        (toks (lex/lexJsSource src))
        (node (lex/tokensToNode toks (src/sourceLength src)))
        (printed (pr/print node src))
        (tilingRes (tr/checkTiling node))]
    (do
      (assert (resultOk? tilingRes) (stringConcat "tiling check for " path))
      (assert (= printed text) (stringConcat "lossless round-trip for " path))
      true)))

fn testFileRoundTrip path: String -> Bool
  (mt (fileRead path)
    ((ok bs) (verifyRoundTrip path (bytesToString bs)))
    ((err msg) (do (assert false (stringConcat "fileRead failed: " msg)) false)))

fn testTrackedFiles -> Bool
  (do
    (assert (testFileRoundTrip "asl/web/vite.config.js") "vite.config.js round-trip")
    (assert (testFileRoundTrip "asl/web/tailwind.config.js") "tailwind.config.js round-trip")
    (assert (testFileRoundTrip "asl/web/plugins/vitePluginAsl.js") "vitePluginAsl.js round-trip")
    (assert (testFileRoundTrip "tests/harnessBench/cases/attention-flood/svc/vendor/uploader.min.js") "uploader.min.js round-trip")
    true))

fn runTests -> Bool
  (do
    (assert (testRegexVsDiv) "regex vs div")
    (assert (testTemplates) "templates")
    (assert (testBigInts) "bigints")
    (assert (testNumbers) "numbers")
    (assert (testUnicode) "unicode")
    (assert (testHashbangAndNewlines) "hashbang and newlines")
    (assert (testJsx) "jsx text")
    (assert (testTrackedFiles) "tracked files round-trip")
    true))
